name: phil/reporting-bundle
description: Dashboards and reports for Symfony: metrics and series contributed by any bundle through a data-source port, dashboards as Twig components with accessible charts in HTML, CSS and SVG and a table of every value, an optional EasyAdmin page, and reports exported to CSV, TSV or JSON, scheduled with Symfony Scheduler and delivered by Mailer or Notifier through a Messenger claim check

suggest.easycorp/easyadmin-bundle: To show a dashboard as a page of an EasyAdmin back office
suggest.phil/ux-css: For the look of the dashboards, on the tokens of PHIL UX
suggest.symfony/http-foundation: To stream a report as a download from a controller
suggest.symfony/mailer: To send the reports by e-mail, the file attached
suggest.symfony/messenger: To export and deliver the reports in a worker
suggest.symfony/notifier: To announce the reports on the channels of Notifier
suggest.symfony/scheduler: To export and deliver the reports on a schedule
suggest.symfony/security-core: To restrict a dashboard to a role
suggest.symfony/ux-live-component: To change a dashboard's period without reloading the page
suggest.symfony/ux-twig-component: For the dashboards, metrics and charts on a page
